description: Uniform certificate of completion for a state-approved driving safety (defensive driving) course, as filed with a court to dismiss a traffic ticket or sent to an insurer for a discount: which course and regulator, the certificate number, the student, the court, the course provider and the dates.

certificate_title.description: Title printed at the top of the certificate, e.g. State of Texas Driving Safety Course Uniform Certificate of Completion.

regulating_agency.description: Government agency that approves and regulates the course, as named in the certification statement.

course_hours.description: Number of hours of instruction the certificate says the student completed, as a number (six (6) hours is 6).

copies.description: Each copy of the certificate printed on the page, in page order, by its copy label (e.g. COURT COPY, INSURANCE COPY).

items.description: Copy label exactly as printed, e.g. COURT COPY.

certificate_number.description: Certificate number printed after CERTIFICATE#, exactly as printed including prefix and hyphen.

student.description: The student who completed the course.

name.description: Student name as printed under Student Name, in the printed Last, First order.

drivers_license_state.description: Two-letter state code of the student's driver licence, printed before the licence number.

drivers_license_number.description: Student driver licence number, digits only, without the state code or dash.

date_of_birth.description: Student date of birth in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

mailing_address.description: Mailing address from the Student Name and Mailing Address block.

court.description: Court the certificate is filed with, from the Court Information block, exactly as printed. Null if no court is given.

course_provider.description: Course provider name as printed under Course Provider. Join letters that are printed spaced out or wrapped across lines into words.

school_classroom.description: School-Classroom identifier, exactly as printed including any suffix after a hyphen.

completion_date.description: Course completion date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

issue_date.description: Certificate issue date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

instructor_license_number.description: Instructor's licence number printed under Instructor TDLR# (or the state regulator's equivalent).

reason.description: Reason the course was taken, as printed under Reason, e.g. Traffic Ticket or Insurance Discount.

student_signed.description: True if the Student's Signature line carries a signature, false if it is blank.
